page_title: ScreenHint - photographic memory at your fingertips

summary.name: ScreenHint
summary.one_liner: ScreenHint is a free Mac app that turns portions of your screen into floating, resizable, always-on-top sticky notes.
use_cases: keep reference information visible while working
stay on task with a pinned note
compare versions of work side by side
sort visual reminders on the desktop
copy a screen region and paste it elsewhere
summary.what_it_does: ScreenHint lets you select a region of your screen and turn it into a floating note that stays on top of other windows. Notes can be resized, moved around the desktop, and pinned to specific desktops. You can copy a hint and paste it anywhere that accepts images. The page says it can extract text from a hint using computer vision. The page describes the app as free and states that it does not store data without permission.
notable: Floating, always-on-top resizable hints made from screen regions
Text extraction from hints using computer vision
Pin hints to desktops and copy/paste them as images
Privacy-first claim: no data stored without permission
caveats: Mac only; no other platforms are named on the page
Page does not describe any paid tier, though it says the app is free
